description: Get a private custom benchmark's current report: members, current stats (headline median/quartiles only when ≥3 comparable priced members — monthly, per-seat and per-call prices are never blended), buyer-tier / provider-type / pricing-unit cohorts, historical index, and data coverage. Pass `benchmark_id` (your cb_ token) as an ARGUMENT.

as_of.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD — reproduce the exact stats + index as they were on that date, using this version's fixed membership

benchmark_id.description: Your cb_ token (bearer secret; passed as an argument, never a URL)

name: get_custom_benchmark
